big_pour.headline: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI ads
big_pour.summary: A new Pennsylvania law requires any advertisement that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a clear disclosure label.
big_pour.why: Readers can know if advertising content they see or hear was created by artificial intelligence.

big_pour.headline: Political models show sharp partisan divides
big_pour.summary: A study found Grok's AI recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.

big_pour.headline: Google privacy update connects Gmail to ads
big_pour.summary: Google updated its privacy policy to indicate that turning on Personal Intelligence provides the company with more data to use for advertising targeting.

office_blend.headline: Bayer Crop Science builds natural language platform
office_blend.summary: Bayer Crop Science built a multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, allowing researchers, breeders, and analysts to ask natural language questions about their analytics platform.

office_blend.headline: IskayPet creates multilingual workplace knowledge assistant
office_blend.summary: Pet care company IskayPet built a corporate assistant using Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases to answer employee questions across four languages and three countries without managing infrastructure.

still_roasting.summary: Anthropic has opened a waitlist for Pro and Max users to access its Claude Duet agent app.
Nirva will release its $249 ambient listening pendant to users by the end of the year.

quick_sips.summary: Microduck robots sold 20,000 units after the Nvidia CEO played with them, performing tricks and making noises on voice command.
OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing "significant risks".
SAP enables professionals to renew their certifications using AI roleplays based on practical, real-world use cases.

stories.label: Open standard
stories.headline: OpenAI donates Open Responses API specification
stories.summary: OpenAI donated its Open Responses API specification for a common language model interface to the open-source Agentic AI Foundation.

stories.label: New tool
stories.headline: Google open-sources TorchTPU for native PyTorch
stories.summary: Google introduced TorchTPU, an open-source native PyTorch stack that allows developers to run PyTorch workloads on Google TPUs.

concept.explanation: The underlying software framework used to build, manage, and run automated AI assistants. In recent news, company Ramp decided to build its own harness after testing existing frameworks.

long_read.headline: What’s the ROI of engineering AI spending?
long_read.summary: The newsletter analyzes data across 27 companies to determine whether increased spending on AI tools actually leads to higher shipping velocity and code output.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: A large language model, an AI trained on huge amounts of text to predict and write words.
word.analogy: Like a barista who has read every coffee menu in the world and can describe any drink you name.

keep_brewing.name: Elements of AI
keep_brewing.description: A free beginner course, no coding or maths needed. One short chapter with your morning coffee.

poll.question: Would you let an AI book your next trip?
